create_DensePoseCheckpointer: create a DensePoseCheckpointer instance to save and load model checkpoints with HRNet weight support
load_checkpoint_with_DensePoseCheckpoint: load a DensePose model checkpoint file using DensePoseCheckpointer to restore model weights
rename_HRNet_weights: rename HRNet pretrained weights by prefixing keys with backbone.bottom_up for DensePose compatibility
detect_HRNet_weights: detect HRNet pretrained weights by checking for 1956 total keys and 1716 stage-prefixed keys
save_DensePose_model: save a DensePose model checkpoint to disk using DensePoseCheckpointer with a specified save directory
